identity.description: Routes your question to the right specialist expert agent(s) in a network of brain-technology researchers, consults across topics when needed, and merges answers into one cited reply.

inputs.description: A research question about the brain-technology corpus (citations returned as [n])
inputs.example: What are the best EEG motor-imagery decoding methods?

outputs.description: The agent’s answer, citing corpus papers as [n]
Cited papers as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)

_default.description: Answer text streamed token-by-token as it is generated

tags.name: Brain Technology
tags.description: Research on BCI, EEG decoding, neural decoding, connectomics and deep learning

tags.name: Research Assistant
tags.description: Answers questions with citations to a 215-paper arXiv corpus

tags.name: Router
tags.description: Cross-topic coordinator for the expert network
examples: How many papers are in the corpus?
How do connectomics and deep learning intersect in brain research?
